Package com.longbridge.agent

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    Agent
    An Agent in a Workspace
    AgentContext
    AI Agent conversation context.
    AgentsResponse
    Response for AgentContext.agents(java.lang.String, com.longbridge.agent.GetAgentsOptions)
    AgentToolFinishedEvent
    The delegated Agent's run has finished.
    AgentToolProgressEvent
    Emitted for each inner tool call the delegated Agent makes.
    AgentToolStartedEvent
    The Agent has delegated to another Agent as a tool.
    ChatFinishedEvent
    Observed once all MessageEvents for this round have been sent, shortly before a WorkflowFinishedEvent.
    ChatStartedEvent
    The run has started.
    ChatTitleUpdatedEvent
    The server auto-generating a short title for the conversation as a UI convenience.
    ContextCompressFinishedEvent
    The context-compression pass has finished.
    ContextCompressStartedEvent
    A context-compression pass has started, marking the start of a context-compression pass triggered by a long conversation.
    ConversationError
    Present when a conversation run failed.
    ConversationResponse
    Response for AgentContext.conversation(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), AgentContext.continueConversation(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>>), and the final result of the streamed counterparts (delivered as WorkflowFinishedEvent.getResponse()).
    ConversationStreamEvent
    One event observed while streaming AgentContext.conversationStream(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String) or AgentContext.continueConversationStream(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>>).
    ConversationStreamPublisher
    A cold Flow.Publisher of ConversationStreamEvents.
    ConversationStreamSubscription
    A Flow.Subscription for a conversation event stream.
    GetAgentsOptions
    Options for AgentContext.agents(java.lang.String, com.longbridge.agent.GetAgentsOptions)
    HumanInteraction
    A single interaction requested while an Agent workflow is paused
    HumanInteractionRequiredEvent
    The run is paused: the Agent needs more information or confirmation from you, carrying the interrupt to resume from via AgentContext.continueConversation(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>>)/ AgentContext.continueConversationStream(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>>).
    Interrupt
    Present when a conversation run is interrupted, waiting for AgentContext.continueConversation(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>>)
    MessageEvent
    An incremental piece of the answer.
    NodeToolUseFinishedEvent
    The tool call has ended.
    NodeToolUseOutputs
    The outputs sub-object of a NodeToolUseFinishedEvent — only carries fields meant for display.
    NodeToolUseStartedEvent
    An ordinary tool call has started.
    OtherEvent
    An event type not recognized by this SDK version, carried as raw JSON text so callers aren't broken by future additions to the API.
    PingEvent
    A heartbeat with no payload, observed at arbitrary points in the stream (including in between MessageEvent chunks).
    PlanChangedEvent
    The Agent created or updated its task plan.
    QueryMaskedEvent
    Sensitive content in the user query was masked before processing.
    Question
    One question the Agent needs you to answer
    QuestionOption
    One option of a Question
    Reference
    A source referenced by the answer
    SubagentFinishedEvent
    The subagent has finished its sub-task.
    SubagentOutputs
    The outputs sub-object of a SubagentFinishedEvent.
    SubagentProgressEvent
    Emitted every time the subagent calls one of its own tools.
    SubagentStartedEvent
    The Agent has spawned a subagent to work on a sub-task.
    ThinkingFinishedEvent
    The reasoning phase is over; answer text (MessageEvent with messageType == "answer") follows.
    ThinkingStartedEvent
    The Agent has entered the reasoning phase (analyzing the question, planning tool calls).
    WorkflowFinishedEvent
    The run finished (succeeded, interrupted, failed, or stopped), carrying the run's outcome.
    WorkflowStartedEvent
    Observed right after a ChatStartedEvent on every run seen so far.
    WorkflowStartedInputs
    The inputs sub-object of a WorkflowStartedEvent, echoing the run's inputs.
    Workspace
    A Workspace the current account belongs to
    WorkspacesResponse
    Response for AgentContext.workspaces()
